A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-L-stonepile-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Stone Pile (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (24 January 2018): Same words as the previous version. The text box is set again and the white italic “E” in the lower border replaces the bronze disc (350 × 490 pixels).

The whole 2018 disc card image and the whole 2018 E card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
